failure_modes: Daily mean reversion documented for yield factors need not apply to the 2s10s spread change or to this regime.
A one-year holdout may not represent other monetary-policy, inflation, or volatility regimes.
CMT values are theoretical constant-maturity par yields rather than executable transaction prices.
Statistical reversal can be too small, unstable, or costly to trade even if the threshold passes.
Overlapping lag pairs create serial dependence, so this gate is an effect-size screen rather than an inference claim.
hypothesis: On the untouched 2022 Treasury holdout, consecutive changes in the 2-year-minus-10-year CMT spread will have lag-1 Pearson correlation at or below -0.10.

bias_controls: The 2022 source snapshot must not enter the project before this specification is committed.
The entire 2022 period is a single untouched holdout; no training or parameter selection is performed.
Only one decision metric and one threshold are permitted.
The predictor uses only the immediately preceding published observation; no same-observation or future value enters it.
All changes use consecutive published observations with no calendar interpolation or missing-value imputation.
The result cannot be represented as a strategy, net return, or capital authorization.

next_experiment: If supported, test the unchanged effect on a new holdout before defining a strategy; if falsified, preserve the failure and stop this daily-reversal branch.

result.interpretation: The untouched holdout falsified or could not evaluate the preregistered one-observation slope-change reversal hypothesis.
